# XtraPath

> XtraPath is the premier visual physics, mathematical animation, and simulation engine. It empowers researchers, educators, and creators to convert code, formulas, and concepts into real-time interactive simulations, auto-compiled LaTeX textbooks, and high-framerate educational animations.

## Core Creative Tools

- [XtraAnim](https://www.xtrapath.com/views/xtraAnim.html): Professional browser IDE for coding visual physics and math animations (Python Manim-style, KaTeX LaTeX, Three.js 3D kinematics, Rapier physics).
- [XtraBook](https://www.xtrapath.com/views/xtraBook.html): Next-generation interactive STEM textbook creator featuring live mathematical notation, auto-LaTeX compilation, and embedded simulation widgets.
- [XtraExplain](https://www.xtrapath.com/views/xtraExplain.html): Step-by-step interactive explanation studio for deconstructing complex physics laws, mathematical proofs, and scientific concepts.
- [Explore Gallery](https://www.xtrapath.com/views/explore.html): Real-time gallery of community-generated simulations, chaos physics, celestial orbits, and particle mechanics.
- [XtraTools](https://www.xtrapath.com/views/xtraTools.html): Complete suite of 15+ specialized STEM utilities including Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX formulas, JSXGraph dynamic geometry, Zdog 3D, and Rapier physics.
- [Research Lab](https://www.xtrapath.com/views/researchLab.html): Interactive 2D kinematics and numerical physics testing environment.
- [Store](https://www.xtrapath.com/views/store.html): Marketplace for mathematical rigs, 3D simulation assets, and educational scene templates.
